strings: m_c steps up as a volunteer for a patrol before fully listening to what it involves.
m_c keeps picking up shiny things.
r_c0 sighs as {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject} watch m_c racing around camp, leaping into decisions without fully thinking.
m_c comes into r_c0's den, sheepishly asking r_c0 if they need any herbs because {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} found a bush and plucked it before asking.
Before anyone told {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to, m_c went out on a solo patrol.
While out on patrol, m_c keeps racing off at the slightest sight of anything in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} peripheral.
